entry.title: BIP 119 CTV activation client
entry.summary: The recent discussions within the Bitcoin community indicate a prevailing skepticism towards the CheckTemplateVerify (CTV) proposition, particularly concerning its activation timeline. This hesitation stems from a perceived lack of demonstrated practical applications that resonate with the average user's experiences, especially in scenarios characterized by high transaction fees. To effectively address these concerns, it is essential to focus on developing and showcasing software that illustrates CTV's benefits in these high-fee environments, enabling users to test and evaluate its utility independently. The emphasis on practical demonstrations could help bridge the gap between theoretical advantages and tangible, user-verifiable benefits, which appears to be a crucial step in gaining broader acceptance within the community. There is an acknowledgment of a significant lag in the development progress required to produce such demonstrative software, highlighting a need for accelerated efforts in this area.
